fix_note: p16.6: gap-fill popover bottom-sheet placement is now CSS-WIDTH-driven (Tailwind max-md:fixed / max-md:!top-auto / max-md:inset-x-2 / max-md:bottom-[calc(60px+env(safe-area-inset-bottom))] / max-md:max-h-[70vh]), no longer gated on a runtime isMobile flag. No JS-set inline top is emitted; the desktop cell-anchor + flip-above are md:-scoped only. Below 768px the header + × close are always on-screen (top>=0) regardless of which cell is tapped.
principle: NN/g #3 User control and freedom; WCAG 2.2 §2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured; Apple HIG modal sheet
location: /projects → PLANNER → COVERAGE grid (Full mode) → tap an upper-viewport paint cell ('Tap to fill this gap') → gap-fill popover [role=dialog]
problem: Gap-fill popover is STILL a desktop anchored popover, not a mobile bottom sheet. Tapping a cell in the upper viewport renders the dialog at y=-235px (top edge 235px ABOVE the viewport). Measured: position:fixed, x=66 y=-235 w=228 h=397, anchoredBottom=false, fullWidth=false. The header is null in-viewport and the × close button (aria-label 'Close gap-fill popover', 44x44) computes onScreen=false — a touch user cannot see or tap it. Escape dismisses it (desktop only); touch users have no visible exit. This is the exact bug UX-1301 was meant to fix.
fix: Make the gap-fill popover a true bottom sheet at <768px: position:fixed; left:0; right:0; bottom:0; width:100vw; max-height:85vh; border-radius:16px 16px 0 0; with a sticky header row containing the title + the existing 44x44 × button at top:0 of the sheet so both are always on-screen. Add a tappable scrim/backdrop that dismisses on tap. Do NOT position relative to the tapped cell on mobile.

principle: Refactoring UI spacing; WCAG 2.2 §2.5.8 Target Size; Fitts's Law
location: /recipes/[id] → STEPS panel → step row (swatch 'Change paint for…' button + 'Delete step' × button)
problem: The swatch/'Change paint' button (x267→311) and the 'Delete step' × button (x286→330) OVERLAP by 25px horizontally and 44px vertically — the × sits on top of the right edge of the colour swatch. At 375px the row's controls are also jammed against the panel's right border and partially clipped. Mis-taps are guaranteed: a user aiming for the swatch may delete the step. UX-1311 not fixed.
fix: In the step row, give the controls a flex container with gap:8px and flex-shrink:0 on each button; reduce the BASECOAT select's max-width so the row fits within the panel padding (account for ~16px panel padding on each side). Ensure no two interactive elements have overlapping bounding boxes. Target: ≥8px gap between swatch and × at 375px.

principle: WCAG 2.2 §2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum, 24px); Apple HIG / Material 44-48px touch target
location: /recipes/[id] → STEPS → paint <select> ('BASECOAT'); also /projects PLANNER form selects & inputs
problem: The recipe step paint <select> is still 134x25px — the exact 25px control UX-1307 named. The step's ICON buttons (Expand notes, Change paint, Delete step) WERE correctly fixed to 44x44, but the <select> dropdown and most form fields were not. Measured: recipe step select 25px; /projects planner selects 27/31/33px, text inputs 33-37px, date 33px; /user password inputs 37px, action buttons 29px, checkboxes 13px. The new SegmentedControl/FilterChip/icon-button primitives are 44px, but legacy <select>/<input>/<textarea>/small <button> were not raised.
fix: Add a global touch baseline for native form controls at <768px: select, input, textarea { min-height:44px; } and small inline action buttons { min-height:44px; padding-block:11px; }. Native checkboxes: wrap in a ≥24px (ideally 44px) tappable label. Prioritise the recipe step select (named in the brief) first.

problem: Wishlist FILTER chips (STATUS Wishlist/Purchased/Hold, CATEGORY All/Any/Box/…) are correctly ~44px with clear active state — that half PASSES. But the per-row STATUS action 'WISHLIST ▾' measures 92x21px with padding:0 (font 16px), and 'OPEN IN ▾' is 96x29px, 'Add' 46x29px. The brief required per-row status actions to be ≥44px chips. 21px fails both the 44px target and the WCAG 2.2 24px floor.
fix: Apply the row-action chip style (min-height:44px; padding:11px 12px) to the per-row 'WISHLIST ▾' status menu trigger and 'OPEN IN ▾' menu, matching the FilterChip primitive already used for the top filters. The current 0px padding on the status trigger is the root cause.

principle: NN/g #1 Visibility of system status; Doherty Threshold; cache-invalidation correctness
location: Service worker registration; cache 'mm-shell-v1'; first cold navigation
problem: A service worker WAS serving stale content. On the very first navigation (before I unregistered the SW) the app threw React error #418 (hydration mismatch: server HTML != client) because the old 'mm-shell-v1' cache returned the PRE-FIX shell HTML against the NEW JS bundle. After unregistering the SW and clearing caches, EVERY subsequent load across the whole session (projects/library/wishlist/recipes/pricing/tools/user, incl. multiple cold reloads) produced ZERO #418 errors — so the new build's hydration is clean. The hazard: the SW cache name is still 'mm-shell-v1' (never bumped), so returning users who cached the broken build will keep getting #418 until the cache invalidates on its own.
fix: Bump the SW cache name on every deploy (e.g. include the build hash: const CACHE='mm-shell-'+BUILD_ID) and delete old caches in the SW 'activate' handler. Call self.skipWaiting() + clients.claim() so the new SW takes over immediately. Optionally switch the shell HTML to network-first so a fresh deploy is never masked by a cached shell. This is what stranded all 15 Round-13 fixes for users on the prior cache.

principle: WCAG 2.2 §1.4.10 Reflow (no horizontal scroll at 320px); Jakob's Law
problem: The library LIST view does not reflow on mobile/tablet. At 375px the content is 431px wide (71px horizontal overflow); at 768px it is 949px wide (196px overflow). The right-hand 'Own' and '★' columns get pushed off the right edge and are partially clipped, so the 44x44 owned/star toggles — though correctly sized — are off-screen unless the user horizontally scrolls. The wishlist/recipes card rebuilds did NOT cover the library list table.
fix: Below 768px, either (a) default the library to GRID view, or (b) reflow each LIST row to a stacked card like wishlist/recipes (name on line 1; brand·line·hex on line 2; Own/★ toggles on line 3) so the row fits 100% width with no horizontal scroll. Ensure documentElement.scrollWidth == clientWidth at 375.

location: App-wide secondary action buttons & native controls (/tools/gradient Pick 55x29 / Save palette 121x29 / Send to recipe 138x29; /recipes Assign 147x29 / Share 147x29; /user buttons 29px, checkboxes 13px)
problem: Beyond the specific items above, a consistent pattern of sub-44px secondary action buttons (29px tall) and tiny native checkboxes (13px) recurs across tools, recipe cards, and the user page. Individually low-friction, collectively this is the dominant remaining touch-quality gap once the named items are fixed.
fix: Add a single global rule scoped to <768px raising all button/select/input/textarea min-height to 44px and wrapping checkboxes/radios in ≥44px tappable labels. One token change cascades across all these surfaces.

principle: Apple HIG app icon; PWA install metadata
problem: Accepted-revert note, not a defect: /favicon.ico returns 404 (text/html). This is the agreed cosmetic revert. The app DOES emit icon links: <link rel=apple-touch-icon href=/icons/apple-touch-icon.png sizes=180x180> (resolves 200, image/png) and <link rel=manifest> with icons 192/512/maskable-512 all defined. So an icon IS present; only the literal favicon.ico 404s. No action required.
fix: No change required (accepted revert). If you ever want to silence the two console 404s, add app/icon.ico or a /favicon.ico route — purely cosmetic.
